bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for infrastructure demolition and site restoration on Minnesota State Colleges and Universities campuses.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+DEMOLITION AND SITE RESTORATION. +]

[+$25,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the Board of Trustees of the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities for demolition and removal of obsolete and underutilized buildings and infrastructure and restoration of the vacant sites to reduce operations, maintenance, and capital renewal costs on Minnesota State Colleges and Universities campuses. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for infrastructure demolition and site restoration on Minnesota State Colleges and Universities campuses.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. DEMOLITION AND SITE RESTORATION.

$25,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the Board of Trustees of the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities for demolition and removal of obsolete and underutilized buildings and infrastructure and restoration of the vacant sites to reduce operations, maintenance, and capital renewal costs on Minnesota State Colleges and Universities campuses.
additions: $25,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the Board of Trustees of the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities for demolition and removal of obsolete and underutilized buildings and infrastructure and restoration of the vacant sites to reduce operations, maintenance, and capital renewal costs on Minnesota State Colleges and Universities campuses.
